{{Top|leg}}
'''Mold stew''' was a type of [[Stew/Legends|stew]] favored by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ugmush]] had a famous recipe for mold stew, and intended to serve it to [[Callista Ming]].<ref name="MS">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref>
